nodes.title: Note: size and Referencen Images
widgets_values:
MiniMax H3 Image doesn't work well in low resolution, so this workflow upscale the input image to 4MP at first.

## Recommended sizes (16MP)

The effective working range of MiniMax-H3-Image is about 4 MP to 20 MP, and it generally gives
the best results at around 16 MP. Common 16 MP sizes are listed below:

| Aspect ratio | Size (width x height) |
| --- | --- |
| 1:1 | 4096x4096 |
| 4:3 / 3:4 | 4736x3552 / 3552x4736 |
| 3:2 / 2:3 | 5024x3360 / 3360x5024 |
| 16:9 / 9:16 | 5472x3072 / 3072x5472 |
| 21:9 | 6272x2688 |

## Multiple image editing

If you want to use multiple image editing:
- add extra `Load Image` nodes
- plug the output to both `Generate Text` 👇 and `MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning`👆 nodes

nodes.widgets_values:
## Comixes official MiniMax-H3-Image cloud profile

This is the native 33B still-image and image-edit checkpoint, not Qwen Image and not the P-H3 pseudo-image adapter. The optional secondary prompt-expander from the upstream template is deliberately removed. The remaining Qwen3-VL file is MiniMax H3's mandatory text/reference encoder; MiniMax-H3-Image generates the pixels.

- RTX 5090: official W4A8 DiT + NVFP4-AWQ H3 encoder, 8 MP reference canvas.
- RTX 6000 Pro: official BF16 DiT + BF16 H3 encoder, 16 MP reference canvas.
- Use one profile consistently across a dataset; do not silently mix it with WAI or Eros frames.

Sources:
- https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
- https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image
